title: Carver Roboweld IPO Details
intro:
Carver Roboweld IPO is a book build issue of ₹28.29 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 35.36 lakh shares of ₹28.29 crore.

Carver Roboweld IPO opens for subscription on Oct 28, 2026 and closes on Oct 30, 2026. The allotment for the Carver Roboweld IPO is expected to be finalized on Nov 2, 2026. Carver Roboweld IPO will list on the BSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Nov 4, 2026.

Carver Roboweld IPO is set issue price band at ₹76 to ₹80 per share. The lot size for an application is 1,600 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,56,000 (3,200 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (4,800 shares), amounting to ₹3,84,000.

Smart Horizon Capital Advisors Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Bigshare Services Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Shreni Shares Ltd.

Refer to Carver Roboweld IPO RHP for detailed Information.

As of July 11, 2026, the Company had an aggregate installed production capacity of 650 tonnes per annum for Metal Cored Wires and Welding Rods, reflecting a capacity CAGR of approximately 30% between Fiscal 2025 and Fiscal 2026.

paragraphs: Incorporated in August 2009, Carver Roboweld Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of welding consumables, including Metal Cored Wires, Welding Rods and Gauging Electrodes, along with the supply of welding spare parts and accessories. The Company has also expanded its offerings to provide value-added engineering solutions to the forging industry, including forging die regeneration and welding robot rental services.

The Company operates its primary manufacturing facility in Bamanbore, Rajkot, Gujarat, with additional service units in Pune, Hosur and Ludhiana, enabling it to serve customers across key industrial markets in India. As of July 11, 2026, the Company had an aggregate installed production capacity of 650 tonnes per annum for Metal Cored Wires and Welding Rods, reflecting a capacity CAGR of approximately 30% between Fiscal 2025 and Fiscal 2026.

Through its subsidiary, Carver Engineering Private Limited, acquired in September 2025, the Company also provides re-conditioning and refurbishment services for plant and machinery across industries such as forging, casting, cement, steel, sugar, power, petroleum, automotive and fabrication. Its engineering services include heavy-duty machining, structural fabrication, repair and refurbishment of hammers and components, and turnkey engineering projects.

The Company has a presence across several Indian states and caters to industrial customers through its welding consumables and engineering solutions. It is ISO 9001:2015 certified and is a Sustaining Corporate Member of the American Welding Society (AWS), reflecting its focus on quality management and adherence to international welding standards.
As of June 30, 2026, the Company had 68 permanent employees and 75 contract workers.
strengths: Strategically located manufacturing facility and service units.
Strategic market coverage across domestic industrial markets.
Focus on meeting customer specifications and quality standards.
Integrated manufacturing and value-added engineering service capabilities.
Experienced promoter and management team with strong welding industry expertise.
Robot rental model supporting long-term customer engagement and recurring revenue.

faqs.question: How to apply in Carver Roboweld IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply for the Carver Roboweld IPO online through the Kite platform under the IPO & Bids section using UPI as the payment method. Steps to Apply for Carver Roboweld IPO through Zerodha Log in to your Zerodha Kite account. On the home page, click IPO & Bids in the top menu. Select the IPO tab and find the Carver Roboweld IPO in the list. Click Apply next to the IPO. Enter your UPI ID, bid quantity, and bid price. Submit the IPO application. Open your UPI app and approve the mandate to complete the application process. For more details, visit the Zerodha IPO Application Process Review .

faqs.question: How to apply for Carver Roboweld IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Carver Roboweld IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Carver Roboweld IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Carver Roboweld IPO will be done on Monday, November 2, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Tue, Nov 3, 2026 . Check the Carver Roboweld IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Carver Roboweld IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Carver Roboweld IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Wed, Nov 4, 2026 .
